name: Gantt
description: Displays Views results as a Gantt chart using the dhtmlxGantt library.
project_description:
This module uses the dhtmlx GANTT javascript library

By default it uses the cdn but you can buy the PRO version and put it in /libraries/gantt/codebase/

 If you are not a drupal expert, you can install the Gantt Node demo and use it.

it basically creates a Node Gantt content and a Ganttt view. Once installed, you can go to /gantt (For the first time go to /node/add/gantt to create a new task). After creating, the interface will be displayed to get started

 

if you like version paragraphs you can try module with paragraphs gantt 

it have same functionality
